Facebook (FB) Market Value Declined While Genesee Valley Trust Company Has Cut Position by $1.03 Million; As Oracle (ORCL) Share Price Declined, Holder Anderson Hoagland & Co Has Decreased Stake by $317,655
June 2, 2018 - By Marguerite Chambers
Genesee Valley Trust Company decreased its stake in Facebook (FB) by 32.62% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Genesee Valley Trust Company sold 5,762 shares as the company’s stock declined 0.01% with the market. The institutional investor held 11,903 shares of the technology company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $2.12M, down from 17,665 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Genesee Valley Trust Company who had been investing in Facebook for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $561.53B market cap company. The stock increased 1.15% or $2.21 during the last trading session, reaching $193.99. About 15.95M shares traded. Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) has risen 21.69% since June 2, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.12% the S&P500.
Anderson Hoagland & Co decreased its stake in Oracle Corp (ORCL) by 17.5% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Anderson Hoagland & Co sold 7,059 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.15% with the market. The institutional investor held 33,275 shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $1.52M, down from 40,334 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Anderson Hoagland & Co who had been investing in Oracle Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $193.30B market cap company. The stock increased 1.35% or $0.63 during the last trading session, reaching $47.35. About 10.86M shares traded. Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL) has risen 3.98% since June 2, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 8.59% the S&P500.

(NASDAQ:ADBE) by 1,481 shares to 20,364 shares, valued at $4.26M in 2018Q1, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) by 11,656 shares in the quarter, for a total of 40,230 shares, and has risen its stake in Dollar General Corp (NYSE:DG).
